summary: Full E2E test of BranchIQ MVP: 4/4 backend pytest passing (root status, consultant/ask with rich context, consultant/ask empty/fallback context, consultant/history). Frontend verified end-to-end via public URL: Executive Dashboard KPI cards render and update on bank switch; Bank Comparison table shows all 9 banks with sort + row activation; Network Analysis renders overall score ring + 6 sub-scores, state filter (12 options) updates the score, formula accordion toggles; BranchIQ Consultant hits real LLM (~2.6KB structured response) with all 5 sections (Executive Answer, Key Evidence, Opportunity Score, Business Reasoning, Recommended Action), supporting-data collapsible works, example chips work; Strategic Recommendations shows matrix + 19 rec cards and opens market-detail-dialog; Sources & Methodology renders sources and formula (0.30 weight etc.); Generate Executive Report dialog opens with 10 sections, Print + Download PDF buttons present. The word 'synthetic' is NOT present anywhere. All 6 nav links work (actual testids: nav-executive-dashboard, nav-bank-comparison, nav-network-analysis, nav-branchiq-consultant, nav-strategic-recommendations, nav-sources-methodology).

issues: Radix a11y console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen reader users'. Wrap title with VisuallyHidden or add explicit DialogTitle. Non-blocking but should be fixed for accessibility.

action_items: Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to Radix DialogContent instances to eliminate a11y console warnings.
Note: review-request mentioned nav-* testids but actual generated testids follow full slug pattern (nav-executive-dashboard, nav-bank-comparison, etc.). Consider documenting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes multiple concerns (models, prompt, routes, DB) in a single 244-line file — still small, but as endpoints grow, split into routers/models/services modules.
consultant_ask persists to Mongo synchronously in the request path; consider fire-and-forget task if latency becomes a concern.
LLM branch: no timeout on LlmChat.send_message — a slow provider could hang the request; consider asyncio.wait_for wrapper.

Consultant response validation is permissive (defaults empty strings) — could still return blank executiveAnswer if LLM returns malformed JSON. Consider forcing fallback when required fields are empty.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded in history endpoint (projection {'_id':0}). Good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_branchiq_api.py. Actual nav testids use full slug (e.g., nav-bank-comparison). Bank selector dropdown options must be selected via role=option, not by text (chart tspan labels can shadow bank names). Consultant LLM call takes ~15-25s; use 90s timeout when waiting for [data-testid=consultant-response].
